guitar.guitaristsText: Dave Murray / Adrian Smith / Janick Gers
guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Murray & Smith signature models) / Gibson Les Paul (Gers)
guitar.evidence: Dave Murray and Adrian Smith both have Fender Stratocaster signature models; well documented for a 3-guitarist lineup.

tone.target: tight British metal crunch with soaring lead bite
tone.profile: tight British metal crunch with soaring lead bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a light boost for aggression, followed by an AC30 TB amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve classic British metal bite and clarity. A dedicated EQ stage shapes the upper mids for lead sustain.
corrections: make leads more singing than gritty

rig.name: Iron Maiden - Fear Of The Dark - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in metal playing.
Provide a light, aggressive boost for the palm-muted gallop rhythm without adding excessive fuzz.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a classic British tube overdrive (like a Plexi booster) rather than a modern high-gain pedal.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain crunch required for British metal while maintaining clarity.
blocks.gap: The general 'Distortion' model is chosen as a versatile, aggressive platform that can emulate Marshall-style gain without being overly scooped or fuzzy.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British tube tone and natural upper-midrange bite essential for Maiden's sound.
Ground the tone in a classic British cabinet sound that complements the AC30 model.
Boost the upper mids (the 'singing' quality) and tighten the low end for gallop rhythm.
Optional subtle chorus for lead sustain and width (kept off by default to avoid sounding too '80s').
blocks.gap: The Chorus is generally avoided, but a very subtle setting can add dimension to the soaring leads.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic echo to enhance the epic feel of the lead passages without muddying the mix.
blocks.gap: A very minimal delay is used, primarily for texture rather than a dominant effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural sense of space and depth for the overall mix.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and punch, especially in the low-mids/upper mids range.

proposals.reason: Enhance British crunch bite and mid-range punch for gallops.
